meta.name: Create narrated blog audio from RSS with Google Gemini, Smallest.ai and WordPress

parameters.jsCode:
const raw = $input.first().json['content:encoded'] || $input.first().json.content || $input.first().json.summary || '';

// Strip all HTML tags
const stripped = raw
  .replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, '')
  .replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, '')
  .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ')
  .replace(/ /g, ' ')
  .replace(/&/g, '&')
  .replace(/</g, '<')
  .replace(/>/g, '>')
  .replace(/"/g, '"')
  .replace(/'/g, "'")
  .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ')
  .trim();

return [{ json: { textContent: stripped } }];

options.systemMessage:
You are an audio content editor for a blog publishing company.

You will receive a blog post in plain text. Your job is to rewrite it so it sounds natural and engaging when read aloud by a text-to-speech engine.

Follow these rules strictly:
- Read the full text and identify the core topic
- Remove any leftover URLs, image captions, photo credits, or meta text
- Replace all bullet points and numbered lists with flowing, connected sentences
- Spell out numbers (e.g. "3" becomes "three"), symbols (e.g. "&" becomes "and"), and abbreviations
- Do NOT include any headings or section titles — write it as one continuous spoken piece
- Add a natural intro at the start: "In today's post, we're covering [topic]..."
- Add a natural outro at the end: "That's all for today. Head to our website to read the full article and subscribe for more content like this."
- Keep the total output under 500 words
- Write at a 7th grade reading level — clear, conversational, and easy to follow

Return ONLY the final rewritten script as plain text.
Do not include any explanation, commentary, JSON, markdown, or formatting of any kind.

IMPORTANT: Your total output must be under 700 words and under 4000 characters. Be concise.

parameters.content:
## Blog RSS to Narrated Audio

### How it works
This workflow automates content repurposing by turning written blog posts into narrated audio articles. It periodically polls your website's RSS feed for new articles. When a new post is detected, a custom JavaScript node strips out HTML tags and prepares the raw text. An AI Agent powered by Google Gemini then rewrites the article content to make it optimal for a natural, spoken-word listening experience.

### Setup steps
* Configure the URL path of your target blog inside the **RSS Feed Trigger** node.
* Authenticate your **Google Gemini** configuration inside the LangChain Chat Model node.
* Connect your **Smallest.ai** credentials to handle speech synthesis.
* Link your target **Google Drive** and **WordPress** accounts to host the audio and publish the updated media elements.

### Customization
You can modify the system instructions in the **AI Agent - Rewrite for Audio** node to dictate a specific tone, add a signature intro/outro, or control the target narration length. You can also alter the WordPress node settings to customize where and how the audio player embed code is added to your articles.
